tracks.about: LIVE RULE since 2026-11-03 (Matt; tightened 2026-11-03 6:43 AM). Between two reads of a game (R 24 h -> W 3 h -> C 70 min before kickoff), Pinnacle's de-vigged chance moves 2 to under 5 pts toward a side, and Hard Rock's price on that side BEATS Pinnacle's fair (no-vig) price on the later read (EV vs Pinnacle's fair > 0). Price window -150..+120, half-point lines only, live eligibility vetoes. The other books' move is logged, not a gate. Flat 1 unit at Hard Rock's price on the later read.
